a: Empty states should teach and guide the next action.
Skeletons/spinners prevent layout jumps and confusion.
Explain what failed and how to recover.
Tell users why access is denied and what to do next.
Confirm deletes with the resource name typed if high impact.
Safe, smart defaults beat complex configuration.
Show advanced options only when needed.
Same actions should look and behave the same across the app.
Design with keyboard, contrast, and labels from the start.
